5.issue: EBS snapshot created from an unencrypted volume
5.risk: Because the source volume (aws_ebs_volume.web_host_storage) is unencrypted, the resulting snapshot is also unencrypted. Unencrypted snapshots can be shared publicly or accessed by unauthorised accounts, exposing all data on the volume
5.remediation: First encrypt the source volume (encrypted = true on aws_ebs_volume.web_host_storage). Alternatively, when creating the snapshot use the aws_ebs_snapshot_copy resource with encrypted = true and a kms_key_id to produce an encrypted copy

14.issue: VPC Flow Logs capture only to S3 without log file validation or encryption in transit enforcement
14.risk: Flow logs delivered to S3 without enforcing TLS (via a bucket policy requiring aws:SecureTransport) can be intercepted in transit. Additionally, without integrity validation it is impossible to detect if log files have been tampered with
14.remediation: Attach an aws_s3_bucket_policy to aws_s3_bucket.flowbucket that denies any request where aws:SecureTransport is false. Also enable SSE-KMS on the bucket so logs are encrypted at rest with a CMK that has its own key policy and rotation enabled
